reviews.text: I want to share Maya's story to give hope to owners of anxious dogs. Maya is a very anxious dog who lives in Paris, a stressful city for her. When I took her in, daily life quickly became difficult for her. She was terrified of everything; the slightest stimulus was painful for her. In addition to her daily fears, Maya couldn't stand being alone. So I contacted a trainer specializing in separation anxiety. She quickly advised me to medicate Maya, which I refused, too worried about what others would think. I soon stopped seeing this trainer to manage the problem on my own. This was a serious mistake; I made the situation worse. Then, one day, I swallowed my pride and realized I couldn't keep pushing Maya beyond her limits, thinking she would get used to it. So I contacted Gaëlle from TLD. In addition to the initial appointment with Gaëlle, I also scheduled an appointment with a veterinary behaviorist to medicate Maya. Once medicated, Maya began to calm down and therefore to improve! Gaëlle was a great help to us; she supported and guided us for many months with kindness and great professionalism. Thanks to her support, Maya made significant progress. And now, with her medication, she lives her daily life more peacefully. It's frowned upon in France to medicate your pet... yet medication helps. Without treatment, Maya wouldn't have progressed and would still be living in constant stress. So if you also have an anxious pet and/or one suffering from separation anxiety, remember that it's not your fault and that you can help them feel better. Get help from caring professionals who listen to your pet. For this, I highly recommend The Learned Dog's services, and in particular their trainer, Gaëlle. Gaëlle is a caring, dedicated, and very professional trainer. A huge thank you!

Thank you, Sandra-Marie, for your exceptional support with my puppy Pumpkin, who was experiencing severe separation anxiety.

Thanks to your insightful approach, kindness, and patience, we made great progress. You truly know how to adapt to both the dog and its owner, and that makes all the difference.

Sandra-Marie is an extremely competent professional, reassuring and generous with her advice and tips. She makes the process much simpler and, above all, much more enjoyable.

I highly recommend her 💛
